dialogues.speaker: Fonck
dialogues.text: What's wrong? Legs shaking from fear?

dialogues.speaker: Fonck
dialogues.text: You didn't seem all that scared when you were out there making your dirty money.

dialogues.speaker: Fonck
dialogues.text: You didn't stop to think about all the people your money laundering was hurting, did you? Now, you've suddenly woken up and realized you'll have to face the ire of the people. Is that it?

dialogues.speaker: Fonck
dialogues.text: When it comes time to face the music, it turns out you're nothing more than a simple coward...

dialogues.speaker: Corder
dialogues.text: I'm ready to face my judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And I'm ready to be in the audience, pelting you with tomatoes.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Or would you prefer rotten eggs?

dialogues.speaker: Corder
dialogues.text: It must be fate that I've ended up in your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Fonck
dialogues.text: Haha! Throw one for my sake, won't you?

dialogues.speaker: Fonck
dialogues.text: Oh, and there's also my colleague, Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand. He has other matters to attend to, so he can't be at the trial. It would be great if you could hurl a... rotten apple in his stead.
